title: Sr. Staff Product Designer
description:
Sr. Staff Product Designer | Grupo SBF (Nike & Centauro)


O Campo de Jogo: No Grupo SBF , não estamos apenas desenhando telas; estamos construindo o ecossistema que movimenta o esporte no Brasil. Como Sr. Staff Product Designer , sua missão é ser o(a) grande estrategista da experiência em um domínio inteiro (tribo).

Você não vai apenas jogar o jogo; você vai desenhar o esquema tático que garante que múltiplas squads e jornadas falem a mesma língua e entreguem uma experiência de elite para milhões de atletas/clientes.


Sua Missão como \"Capitão(ã)\" do Domínio:

  • Visão Macro: Orquestrar a qualidade e a coerência da experiência em toda a tribo, conectando os pontos entre múltiplos produtos e squads.
  • Tática e Estratégia: Definir padrões de solução que reduzam a dívida de UX e elevem a qualidade estrutural de tudo o que entregamos.
  • Influência no Placar: Direcionar decisões de produto baseadas em dados e métricas, influenciando o roadmap e garantindo que o design seja um motor de negócio.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar em contextos de alta ambiguidade, transformando problemas complexos em jornadas fluidas e consistentes.


O que buscamos no seu \"Treino\" (Requisitos):

  • Experiência de Elite: Carreira consolidada em Product Design (Web e Mobile), com domínio completo de Discovery, Delivery e acompanhamento de métricas.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de estruturar fluxos complexos e jornadas com múltiplos estados, sempre olhando para o Design System como um aliado.
  • Mentalidade de Coach: Habilidade de articular trade-offs e facilitar alinhamentos difíceis entre usuários, tecnologia e as metas de negócio.
  • Foco no Resultado: Saber exatamente como as suas decisões de design mexem o ponteiro da conversão, retenção e engajamento.


Pontos Extras (Desejável):

  • Se você já jogou no campeonato do Varejo Digital ou em contextos de escala massiva.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

title: Sales Executive
description:
About the job


Come Join our Community Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!


The Sales Executive drives B2B sales growth and business partnerships for Financial Institutions and corporate segments at Airport. Prospects and engages potential clients, promotes brand awareness through visits and training, and supports sales initiatives and events. Monitors partner performance, identifies market opportunities, and provides competitive insights into internal teams. Prepares visit agendas and reporting to support strategic decision-making.

• Hunter-like profile, strategic and results-oriented, with business acumen and a focus on revenue generation and growth.

• Excellent verbal and written communication, negotiation skills, and persuasive presentation abilities.

• Strong relationship and networking skills with decision-makers in the financial sector.

• Proactive, autonomous, resilient, and focused on problem-solving.

• Fluent in English and Advanced Level in Spanish


Experience:

• 5+ years in B2B sales, preferably in the financial sector (banks, credit card companies, payment processors, brokerage firms, fintechs)

• Knowledge of loyalty/rewards programs.

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and an up-to-date pipeline.


Education:

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related fields.


Desirable Skills:

• Experience with complex institutional clients (banks, insurance companies, credit card companies).

• Experience in the airport sector and relationships with concessionaires, airlines, and other operators in the sector.

• Data-driven.

• Background in technology companies outside the financial sector.

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. title: Técnico em Automação
description:
A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática.


Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!


Atuação: 100% Presencial

Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição)

Modelo de Trabalho: CLT


RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO:

Será responsável por executar atividades de instalação, integração, testes e comissionamento de sistemas de automação industrial. Atuará na montagem e interligação de painéis de controle, instalação de dispositivos de campo, conexão de CLPs, remotas e IHMs, além da realização de testes funcionais, start-up de máquinas e suporte ao comissionamento elétrico e de software.

O profissional atuará garantindo a correta implementação dos sistemas de automação em máquinas, equipamentos e linhas de produção industriais, assegurando conformidade com projetos elétricos, padrões técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidade da empresa.


DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

  • Realizar instalação e interligação de painéis elétricos e painéis de automação conforme diagramas e especificações técnicas.
  • Efetuar passagem, identificação, organização e terminação de cabos de potência, controle e comunicação.
  • Instalar infraestrutura elétrica: cable trays, eletrocalhas, leitos, dutos, conduítes e acessórios.
  • Executar conexão de CLPs, remotas de I/O, IHMs, inversores de frequência, sensores, atuadores e demais dispositivos de automação.
  • Efetuar testes de I/O (entrada e saída) e validação de sinais de campo.
  • Realizar testes funcionais em sistemas de automação e equipamentos industriais.
  • Executar parametrização de CLPs, inversores de frequência e dispositivos inteligentes.
  • Realizar diagnósticos e solução de falhas elétricas e de automação.
  • Executar ajustes e modificações em programas de CLP e interfaces HMI quando necessário.
  • Participar de atividades de start-up de máquinas e linhas de produção.
  • Interpretar diagramas elétricos, listas de I/O, arquiteturas de rede industrial e documentação técnica de automação.
  • Realizar integração de sistemas de automação e comunicação industrial.
  • Atualizar documentação técnica e registrar ajustes realizados durante testes e comissionamento (“Asbuilt”).
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de engenharia durante fases de testes, comissionamento e start-up.
  • Cumprir padrões de qualidade, normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança (NR-10, NR-12 e normas aplicáveis).
  • Realizar atividades de instalação e suporte técnico em campo quando necessário.


CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA:

  • Curso Técnico em Automação Industrial, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Desejável: 5 (cinco) anos de experiência prática em automação industrial, instalação de sistemas de controle ou comissionamento de equipamentos industriais, testes de sinais de campo, leitura de diagramas elétricos e integração de dispositivos de automação.


OUTROS ATRIBUTOS DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Experiência com CLPs Siemens e/ou Rockwell / Allen-Bradley.
  • Conhecimento em redes industriais como Profinet e EtherNet/IP.
  • Experiência em indústria de latas de alumínio será considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência em automação de transportadores será considerada um diferencial.
  • Experiência com sistemas de tratamento de biogás será considerada um diferencial.


BENEFÍCIOS


Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos:


  • Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil)
  • Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações
  • Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas
  • Programa de bônus
  • Gratificação em viagens corporativas

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js

  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

  • Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de sistemas, APIs e microserviços;

  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender continuamente;

  • Interesse por inovação e desafios tecnológicos.

Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Oportunidade para Videomaker Assistente e Videomaker Pleno em Agência de Marketing focada em gastronomia


A Luks Mídia é uma agência de marketing 360º localizada em Belo Horizonte (MG). Somos especializados no setor gastronômico, atendendo referências como: Dorival Bar e Parrilla, Tizé Bar, Boi Vindo, Adega Steakhouse entre outras dezenas de clientes.


Essa oportunidade é pra você que:


  • É formado em cinema, publicidade e propaganda ou áreas relacionadas
  • Possui experiência prática em produções reais (buscamos alguém bem preparado)
  • Possui habilidade em edição de vídeo (CapCut, Premiere, Da Vinci ou relacionados)
  • Gosta de trabalhar com vídeo, set de gravação e produções cinematográficas
  • Tem interesse na cena gastronômica de BH e região
  • Tem boas habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento com o cliente


Sua função na prática:


Você atuará como Videomaker Pleno nas produções dos nossos clientes:


  • Auxílio na montagem e posicionamento de iluminação
  • Captação de imagens (vídeos e fotos) com câmera primária ou secundária
  • Organização de equipamentos
  • Senso crítico na montagem dos produtos (food styling)
  • Contato com clientes, ajudando a manter um ambiente leve e profissional no set


Além disso, tarefas seundárias englobam:


  • Participação nas reuniões internas
  • Edição de vídeos
  • Upload e organização de Google Drive pós gravação
  • Redigir relatórios após as gravações


PS: não é necessário possuir equipamento próprio, nossa agência possui uma ampla gama de equipamentos audiovisuais (iluminação, câmeras, lentes, tripé, gimbal, drone, etc.). Todavia, é considerado um diferencial.


O processo:


1) Entrevista:

Bate-papo com o objetivo de conhecer melhor o candidato(a).


2) Dinâmica:

Avaliaremos habilidades do candidato(a) relacionadas a vaga.


Remuneração:


  • Pagamento mensal fixo
  • Cobertura total de custos de transporte
  • Benefícios adicionais em dinâmicas de cultura (ex: remuneração extra, viagens, consumação em clientes da cartela da agência)


Expectativa de fixo: Videomaker Assistente (R$3.300) e Videomaker Pleno (R$5.250)

+ bônus por gravações aos fins de semana e/ou feriados e adicionais

title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer (in the Netherlands)
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands), we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the Hardware Design Engineer with passionate about high-speed, low power designs that we are looking for?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer I TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer?

As a Senior Hardware Design Engineer at TOPIC, you are a key member of our Hardware team and play an important role in complex development projects. You act as a trusted sparring partner for colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders, translating concepts into clear technical direction for the team. You take a leading role in the design of complex hardware systems while effectively prioritizing multiple projects and clients.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer:

  • Implement a diverse range of innovative solutions across industries, from designing cutting-edge medical IoT devices to developing next-generation high-speed computing platforms and everything in between.
  • Take full ownership of design activities, ensuring the quality, integrity, and timely delivery of solutions.
  • Develop and validate complete hardware subsystems, based on high-level requirements and detailed project specifications.
  • Conduct in-depth analyses and studies, applying proven methodologies to deliver high-quality, effective solutions.
  • Participate in the entire development lifecycle: from system requirement gathering and translating these into hardware architecture, to PCB design & routing, schematic design, testing, and integration.
  • Provide senior-level expertise and guidance, supporting multiple teams within your domain and helping to elevate the overall technical craftsmanship of the organization.
  • Identify risks and opportunities both within and beyond the project scope, ensuring relevant stakeholders are engaged and proactive.
  • You are a sparring partner for junior engineers and your teammates.
  • You have a proven track record in a multidisciplinary team (SW/FW/HW)
  • Keeping up to date with the latest (high speed) technologies and converging them to the team.


What do we offer you?


This will make you smarter :

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better :

  • Permanent contract;
  • An all-in employment package between €62.000 and €85.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise;
  • 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands).


This will keep you healthy :

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Hardware Design Engineer?

  • You have a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering and at least 5 years of professional experience;
  • You have a successful track record in high-tech hardware development projects (high-speed, low-power designs, combining FPGAs with ARM microprocessors, DDR4 memories, fast ADCs and radio modules such as WiFi and Bluetooth) and are familiar with tools such as Mentor Graphics Xpedition, Altium Designer, HyperLinx;
  • You are proficient in the full development cycle; from the translation of system requirements into hardware design architecture and the schematic design, PCB design & routing to testing and integration;
  • You are used to working in a structured (ISO-13485) development process, and can prioritize multiple projects and clients;
  • You are communicative, have a can-do mentality and are a high-level conceptual thinker. This makes you a trusted sparring partner and able to take a lead role in designing complex hardware development projects;
  • You have excellent oral and written command of the English language is required for this role, command of the Dutch language is an advantage .


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future.   • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.

  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Build AI-Powered Computer-Vision Products with Us


Our company specializes in AI-driven computer vision solutions for the wood industry, enhancing production efficiency and sustainability. Collaborating with the world's leading sawmills, we play a pivotal role in supporting the shift to a carbon-neutral future. Our focus is on innovation and technology, fostering automation to minimize waste.


We work in small, highly skilled teams that embody a startup-like mentality, embracing diverse cultures from Belgium, Romania, Spain, and Brazil. As a horizontal organization, we value initiative and self-drive. Our development team boasts members with over 15 years of experience, including key figures such as founding members and team leads who have successfully guided startups to exits exceeding 150 million dollars.


We're Looking for You!


Are you excited to learn and grow in a fast-paced tech environment? Do you want to work with experienced professionals who can mentor you? If yes, we'd love to have you join our team.


Your Role:


  • Work in an Agile environment with a team of experienced developers, researchers, and business analysts
  • Architect and develop highly performant software components, with an emphasis on scalability and robustness
  • Build back-end components for web-based applications built around the product
  • Actively participate with ideas for improving the product
  • Write automated tests and document your code
  • Participate in code review sessions
  • Engage in knowledge transfer and coaching sessions – you’ll have the opportunity to understand how the entire ecosystem works and contribute to components of the project which you might be interested in – AI, computer vision, HPC.
  • Work and innovate with R&D to integrate research results into the final product


What We Need from You:


Every Neural Grader team member is an important asset to us and makes their mark on the projects they’re working on. Here is what we’re looking for in this role:


  • Technical Bachelor's degree
  • Have a very high understanding of OOP concepts and comprehensive knowledge across programming fields
  • Self-driven and able to drive tasks to completion independently
  • Pragmatic and goal-oriented
  • Very good technical knowledge and work experience with Java, Spring Boot, JPA, SQL
  • Ability to architect complex features, focusing on performance
  • Image processing/computer vision skills are a plus


What We Offer


  • Flat structure—initiative beats hierarchy
  • Competitive salary
  • Training, coaching, and certifications
  • Periodic performance evaluations
  • Performance or special occasion bonuses
  • Remote work
  • Team buildings
  • Plus, a high-tech lab with industrial cameras and lasers


Ready to Apply?

We're excited to hear from you! Send us your application and let's start the conversation about your future with us.

title: Global Campus Outreach Partner
description:
We are looking for dynamic and well-connected individuals within the university ecosystem to help expand our student contributor network for AI/LLM evaluation projects.


As a Country Campus Outreach Partner, you will play a key role in connecting with universities, student communities, and academic networks to onboard qualified students interested in flexible AI-related gig opportunities.


This is an ideal opportunity for individuals passionate about AI, education, and community building, while gaining exposure to the global AI ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build relationships with universities, career centers, and student organizations within your country.
  • Promote SME on demand/short term AI & LLM centric opportunities to university students.
  • Identify and engage student ambassadors and academic contacts to expand outreach.
  • Conduct virtual information sessions or campus awareness activities.
  • Support onboarding and orientation of new student contributors.
  • Track outreach progress and provide monthly updates on engagement and onboarding metrics.
  • Ensure a steady pipeline of qualified student participants for gig projects.


Success Metrics for the given role:


  • Number of universities engaged
  • Number of student contributors onboarded
  • Engagement sessions conducted
  • Active participation and task completion by onboarded students

  • Apoiar auditorias e atividades de compliance

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK JÚNIOR

  • Stack Principal: Experiência sólida com Node.js e React.js;

Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;


Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;

  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;

  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).

  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico.   • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.

  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
