title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js

  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)

  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Team Leader | adidas Nova América
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.


Principais Responsabilidades:


• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos:


• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior C/C++ – Meios de Pagamento e TEF


Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em C/C++ e profundo conhecimento em meios de pagamento, especialmente em TEF (Transferência Eletrônica de Fundos). O(a) profissional atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de pagamento, integrando POS, pinpads e sistemas de adquirência, com foco em desempenho, segurança e alta disponibilidade.


  • Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações em C/C++ voltadas para meios de pagamento e TEF.
  • Implementar e manter integrações com adquirentes, gateways e dispositivos de automação comercial.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de problemas técnicos em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança e mensageria em transações financeiras.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times multidisciplinares (QA, produto, infraestrutura).


  • Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em C e/ou C++.
  • Sólida vivência com TEF e meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com integração de POS, pinpads e automação comercial.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação (TCP/IP, porta serial).
  • Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 8583 (mensageria para transações financeiras).
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle (consultas, procedures).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Linux e/ou Windows embarcados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de versionamento (ex: Git).

  • Experiência com criptografia e segurança da informação.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento embarcado ou ambientes de tempo real.
  • Vivência com testes automatizados e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Salesforce TPM Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Technical Program Manager (Salesforce TPM)

A Technical Program Manager at Salesforce (or in a Salesforce-focused role) is responsible for the end-to-end execution of complex technical initiatives. They bridge the gap between high-level organizational strategy and technical engineering execution.


Core Responsibilities:

Program Delivery: Overseeing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from initiation to completion using Agile and Lean methodologies.

Stakeholder Alignment: Leading Steering Committee meetings to make key decisions, remove obstacles, and align vision across cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Leads, UX).

Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identifying blockers, managing dependencies across multiple scrum teams, and developing mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Driving engineering excellence by refining release planning and program structures.


Required Skills:

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Technical Depth: Deep understanding of SaaS/PaaS business models and the ability to master technical subjects relevant to the program.

Communication: Outstanding executive presence with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Trade Promotion Management (Salesforce TPM)

If the role is specifically for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, TPM refers to a consultant or manager who optimizes how brands manage trade spend and promotions.

Getmereferred.com

Getmereferred.com


Core Responsibilities:

TPM Implementation: Designing and configuring components like promotion planning, fund management, and claims settlement.

Industry Expertise: Applying knowledge of the Consumer Goods (CPG) industry to drive ROI through AI-powered scenario modeling and budget optimization.

Integration: Ensuring TPM solutions integrate seamlessly with other modules like Sales Cloud or Marketing Cloud.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

Certifications in Salesforce (Admin, Platform App Builder) are often mandatory for these specialist roles.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

O(a) profissional atuará no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de pagamento, integrando POS, pinpads e sistemas de adquirência, com foco em desempenho, segurança e alta disponibilidade.

  • Implementar e manter integrações com adquirentes, gateways e dispositivos de automação comercial.
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de problemas técnicos em ambientes de missão crítica.

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times multidisciplinares (QA, produto, infraestrutura).

  • Experiência com integração de POS, pinpads e automação comercial.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação (TCP/IP, porta serial).

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior, com forte viés em backend , para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

Analista de Negócios - Remoto

– Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

– Seguro de vida;

– Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

– GetVibes – nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuação em uma empresa global da área da saúde.
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.


O que esperamos de você:


• Experiência com atuação junto à área de negócios

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

• Apoio na documentação e manutenção de processos, com acompanhamento de KPIs e geração de insights

title: Product Owner SR
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Liderar a visão e execução do produto, alinhando com as estratégias de negócios e necessidades do cliente.
  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e design para otimizar a experiência do usuário.
  • Definir e acompanhar OKRs/KPIs, utilizando dados para impulsionar decisões e melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar reuniões ágeis e manter comunicação fluida com stakeholders.
  • Aplicar tecnologias de IA para aprimorar o produto e a experiência do usuário.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado para identificar tendências e oportunidades de inovação.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Formação superior na área de TI
  • Experiência sólida como Product Owner de Produto Digital Sênior.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de IA, como chatbots e IA generativa.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e gestão de backlog.
  • Habilidade para definir e otimizar OKRs/KPIs com base em dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.

Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior (Plataforma)
description:

Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)

title: Senior Application Development Consultant
description:
Job Title :: Senior Application Development Consultant

Location :: Brazil Remote

Job Type :: Contract

Language Requirement: English & Portuguese are a must, Spanish is desirable

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Development Consultant with extensive experience in application development, DevOps practices, and application architecture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in utilizing the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to deliver innovative solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of application solutions using best practices in application development.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance application performance.

• Utilize the Agent Development Kit (ADK) to create robust applications that meet client requirements.

• Architect scalable and efficient application solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and team members.

• Engage with clients to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Ensure adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high-quality standards.

Mandatory Skills:

• Proven experience in application development with a strong portfolio of completed projects.

• Expertise in DevOps methodologies and tools.

• Proficient in using the Agent Development Kit (ADK).

• Strong understanding of application architecture principles.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and deployment.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

• Experience in Agile project management methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in application development and consultancy.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Analista de Negócios - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

– Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

– Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

– Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

– Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

– Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

– Auxílio creche;

– Seguro de vida;

– Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

– Parceria com instituições de ensino;

– Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

– Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

– Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

– Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

– Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

– GetVibes – nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuação em uma empresa global da área da saúde.
  • Atuação 100% home office, em horário comercial.
  • Contratação CLT.


O que esperamos de você:


• Experiência com atuação junto à área de negócios

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

• Apoio na documentação e manutenção de processos, com acompanhamento de KPIs e geração de insights

• Facilidade de comunicação com diferentes stakeholders

• Business cases e Business plans

• Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas como Jira ou Azure

• Inglês intermediário/avançado



Diferenciais:

  • Experiencia com saúde
  • Certificação Agil



O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Senior Application Development Consultant
description:
Job Title :: Senior Application Development Consultant

Location :: Brazil Remote

Job Type :: Contract

Language Requirement: English & Portuguese are a must, Spanish is desirable

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Development Consultant with extensive experience in application development, DevOps practices, and application architecture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in utilizing the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to deliver innovative solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of application solutions using best practices in application development.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance application performance.

• Utilize the Agent Development Kit (ADK) to create robust applications that meet client requirements.

• Architect scalable and efficient application solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and team members.

• Engage with clients to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Ensure adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high-quality standards.

Mandatory Skills:

• Proven experience in application development with a strong portfolio of completed projects.

• Expertise in DevOps methodologies and tools.

• Proficient in using the Agent Development Kit (ADK).

• Strong understanding of application architecture principles.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and deployment.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

• Experience in Agile project management methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in application development and consultancy.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

title: Sr. Staff Product Designer
description:
Sr. Staff Product Designer | Grupo SBF (Nike & Centauro)


O Campo de Jogo: No Grupo SBF , não estamos apenas desenhando telas; estamos construindo o ecossistema que movimenta o esporte no Brasil. Como Sr. Staff Product Designer , sua missão é ser o(a) grande estrategista da experiência em um domínio inteiro (tribo).

Você não vai apenas jogar o jogo; você vai desenhar o esquema tático que garante que múltiplas squads e jornadas falem a mesma língua e entreguem uma experiência de elite para milhões de atletas/clientes.


Sua Missão como \"Capitão(ã)\" do Domínio:

  • Visão Macro: Orquestrar a qualidade e a coerência da experiência em toda a tribo, conectando os pontos entre múltiplos produtos e squads.
  • Tática e Estratégia: Definir padrões de solução que reduzam a dívida de UX e elevem a qualidade estrutural de tudo o que entregamos.
  • Influência no Placar: Direcionar decisões de produto baseadas em dados e métricas, influenciando o roadmap e garantindo que o design seja um motor de negócio.
  • Liderança Técnica: Atuar em contextos de alta ambiguidade, transformando problemas complexos em jornadas fluidas e consistentes.


O que buscamos no seu \"Treino\" (Requisitos):

  • Experiência de Elite: Carreira consolidada em Product Design (Web e Mobile), com domínio completo de Discovery, Delivery e acompanhamento de métricas.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Tech Recruiter
description:
Escopo da Prestação de Serviços – Recrutamento Tech (PJ)


  • Atuar na condução de processos de recrutamento e seleção para posições de tecnologia , prestando serviços especializados desde o alinhamento do perfil até a conclusão da contratação, conforme demandas acordadas.
  • Prestar apoio consultivo aos líderes técnicos e gestores , contribuindo com análises sobre necessidades do negócio, composição dos times, arquitetura técnica e desafios das posições, mantendo autonomia na condução técnica do trabalho.
  • Realizar mapeamento e hunting ativo de talentos em diferentes níveis de senioridade, por meio de canais especializados, networking profissional e ferramentas de recrutamento, definindo estratégias de busca de forma independente.
  • Avaliar perfis profissionais com base em critérios técnicos e comportamentais , considerando stacks modernas de desenvolvimento, práticas de qualidade de engenharia e padrões de mercado, com foco na aderência às demandas das posições.
  • Conduzir entrevistas técnicas iniciais , validando experiências em backend, frontend, cloud, qualidade de engenharia e práticas de CI/CD, emitindo parecer técnico para apoio à tomada de decisão dos gestores.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de atração, priorização de demandas e análise de indicadores , contribuindo com dados e insights que auxiliem o processo decisório, sem exclusividade ou subordinação.
  • Zelar por uma experiência clara e transparente aos candidatos , garantindo comunicação adequada durante o processo, alinhada à imagem e aos valores institucionais da empresa.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de recrutamento tech , sugerindo otimizações, novas ferramentas, automações e boas práticas, conforme sua expertise profissional.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial como apoio à produtividade, análise de perfis e suporte às decisões técnicas, conforme metodologia própria de trabalho.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.

  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Salesforce TPM Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Technical Program Manager (Salesforce TPM)

A Technical Program Manager at Salesforce (or in a Salesforce-focused role) is responsible for the end-to-end execution of complex technical initiatives. They bridge the gap between high-level organizational strategy and technical engineering execution.


Core Responsibilities:

Program Delivery: Overseeing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from initiation to completion using Agile and Lean methodologies.

Stakeholder Alignment: Leading Steering Committee meetings to make key decisions, remove obstacles, and align vision across cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Leads, UX).

Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identifying blockers, managing dependencies across multiple scrum teams, and developing mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Driving engineering excellence by refining release planning and program structures.


Required Skills:

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Technical Depth: Deep understanding of SaaS/PaaS business models and the ability to master technical subjects relevant to the program.

Communication: Outstanding executive presence with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Trade Promotion Management (Salesforce TPM)

If the role is specifically for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, TPM refers to a consultant or manager who optimizes how brands manage trade spend and promotions.

Getmereferred.com

Getmereferred.com


Core Responsibilities:

TPM Implementation: Designing and configuring components like promotion planning, fund management, and claims settlement.

Industry Expertise: Applying knowledge of the Consumer Goods (CPG) industry to drive ROI through AI-powered scenario modeling and budget optimization.

Integration: Ensuring TPM solutions integrate seamlessly with other modules like Sales Cloud or Marketing Cloud.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

Certifications in Salesforce (Admin, Platform App Builder) are often mandatory for these specialist roles.

  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5º marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).


Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.


E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.


E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!


Como será o seu dia a dia?


Responsável por liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time de vendedores de campo, garantindo simultaneamente: Aquisição de novos clientes (Hunter) e Gestão, expansão e retenção da base ativa (Farmer).

Coordenação Comercial

  • Coordenar o time de vendedores de campo, garantindo execução do plano comercial
  • Acompanhar metas individuais e coletivas, apoiando o time no atingimento dos resultados
  • Construir e apresentar relatórios de performance para a gerência e diretoria
  • Garantir disciplina comercial, qualidade de abordagem e uso correto do CRM

Atuação Hunter – Novos Negócios

  • Apoiar e participar da prospecção ativa de novos clientes PJ
  • Planejar e otimizar rotas de visitas de campo
  • Apoiar negociações e fechamentos mais complexos
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com clientes atendidos pela concorrência
  • Garantir excelência na apresentação das soluções

Atuação Farmer – Gestão da Base

  • Coordenar a gestão da carteira de clientes PJ
  • Garantir retenção, redução de churn e aumento de satisfação
  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell junto à base ativa
  • Atuar como ponto de apoio para resolução de demandas e conflitos
  • Acompanhar a experiência do cliente ao longo do ciclo pós-venda

Interface Interna

  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como suporte técnico, marketing, operações e produtos
  • Garantir o correto encaminhamento e acompanhamento das demandas dos clientes



O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.


Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Graduação completa, preferencialmente em Engenharia, Tecnologia ou Administração
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em telecomunicações, tecnologia ou soluções digitais
  • Vivência em Field Sales (vendas presenciais)
  • Experiência prévia como vendedor sênior ou líder de equipe
  • Conhecimento em Portfólio de produtos e serviços de telecomunicações para empresas
  • Domínio de CRM, ferramentas de gestão comercial e rotas de campo
  • Técnicas de prospecção, negociação, fechamento e pós-venda
  • Gestão de contas, retenção, upsell e cross-sell
  • Noções de métricas de satisfação e sucesso do cliente
  • Pacote Office (Excel intermediário)
  • Inglês básico (leitura, escrita e comunicação em ambiente profissional)

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Senior (GraphQL), Brasil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 8,000 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.


Job Requirements:


▪ 5+ yrs experience as a developer working on large, distributed systems and GraphQL

▪ 8+ yrs development in any language, 4 most recent years in Java developing server-side applications ▪ Expert in Core Java 1.8 and above

▪ Demonstrable experience with Restful web services using JSON (JSON-API and/or GraphQL preferred)

▪ Demonstrable proficiency with Spring, Spring Boot and development of RESTful/JSON web services in a micro-service architecture

▪ Proficient with design methods/patterns (e.g., DRY, SOLID, ReST) and their practical application

▪ Demonstrable proficiency with JUnit, Mockito, Assert-J

▪ Proficient level experience with messaging frameworks such as JMS and ActiveMQ

▪ Demonstrable proficiency with Agile and Test-Driven development

▪ Proficient level experience with Relational and NoSQL databases

▪ Proficient level experience with database access using Spring JDBC template, JPA, Hibernate (against SQL Server, preferred but not required)

▪ Proficient in MacOS, Unix, and Linux

▪ High-level understanding of in-memory distributed data storage systems like memcache, ehcache, Hazelcast

▪ Proficient in Git

▪ Experience with continuous integration systems like Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub actions

▪ Preferred experience with cloud deployments (Preferably Azure)

▪ Experience with build tools like Maven

▪ Experience with using the IntelliJ IDE

▪ Proficient with profiling tools

▪ Able to compare and contrast third party libraries

▪ Excellent English Level (verbal and written) communication skill

▪ Working knowledge of Windows, Unix, and Linux

▪ Highly motivated and driven by a desire to solve difficult problems, and learn new technology

▪ Experience with international software development (multi-lingual, multi-currency, geographic, and locale awareness)

▪ Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or software development-related field

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Salesforce TPM Analyst
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Technical Program Manager (Salesforce TPM)

A Technical Program Manager at Salesforce (or in a Salesforce-focused role) is responsible for the end-to-end execution of complex technical initiatives. They bridge the gap between high-level organizational strategy and technical engineering execution.


Core Responsibilities:

Program Delivery: Overseeing the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from initiation to completion using Agile and Lean methodologies.

Stakeholder Alignment: Leading Steering Committee meetings to make key decisions, remove obstacles, and align vision across cross-functional teams (Product Owners, Scrum Leads, UX).

Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identifying blockers, managing dependencies across multiple scrum teams, and developing mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Driving engineering excellence by refining release planning and program structures.


Required Skills:

Experience: Typically in enterprise software or technical program management.

Technical Depth: Deep understanding of SaaS/PaaS business models and the ability to master technical subjects relevant to the program.

Communication: Outstanding executive presence with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Trade Promotion Management (Salesforce TPM)

If the role is specifically for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, TPM refers to a consultant or manager who optimizes how brands manage trade spend and promotions.

TPM Implementation: Designing and configuring components like promotion planning, fund management, and claims settlement.

Integration: Ensuring TPM solutions integrate seamlessly with other modules like Sales Cloud or Marketing Cloud.

Required Skills:

Strong understanding of the TPM lifecycle: planning, budgeting, execution, and analytics.

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred
